capabilities: Render 3D model files inline in notes and in a direct file view
Convert CAD, FBX, 3MF and DAE formats to GLB using local external tools
Inspect registered model parts and embed persistent part presentations
Generate structured knowledge notes and part drafts from loaded models
Annotate, measure and capture PNG snapshots of models
disambiguation: Not an AI plugin despite the name; AI appears only as an optional remote draft service for knowledge-note generation, while the core job is 3D viewing and annotation.
extras: The manifest flags the plugin as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. SPLAT/SPZ/SOG preview is disabled in packaged builds pending a local-only loader. Mobile supports direct formats only; local conversion is desktop-only. Optional remote draft service sends sanitized model evidence to a user-configured POST /draft-note endpoint; everything else is local-only.
problem: Obsidian cannot preview or annotate 3D model files, so model evidence has to live outside the vault instead of being embedded and linked in notes.

relations.evidence: FBX files are converted to GLB through the local FBX2glTF binary.

requires.name: Python + CadQuery/OCCT, FreeCAD, trimesh, obj2gltf, FBX2glTF (desktop converters)

summary: 3D model viewer that renders GLB, GLTF, STL, OBJ and PLY files in notes and turns model parts into linked knowledge notes.
